## Summary

Describe what happened and what you expected.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest synthetic workspace and exact commands needed to reproduce the issue. Do not include API keys, private files, or personal data.

## Environment

- Kryptic version or commit:
- Operating system:
- Node version:
- Provider mode: offline / Google / OpenAI / Claude

## Evidence

Paste the relevant structured error, test command, exit code, or run ID. Redact secrets and URLs containing private information.
